사고 처리

탐지된 사고를 접수부터 종료까지 처리하는 화면입니다. 지금 어느 단계인지와 담당자를 보여 주고, 처리한 일을 기록으로 남깁니다.

언제 쓰는가
Critical 탐지처럼 사람이 맡아 분석하고 조치해야 하는 사고를 한 화면에서 처리할 때 씁니다.
비슷한 패턴
사고가 아닌 자산이나 정책 하나를 보는 화면은 상세 화면을 씁니다.

Composition

이 패턴이 조합하는 컴포넌트입니다. 세부 옵션은 각 컴포넌트 페이지에 있습니다.

.card .card-meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:max-content 1fr;gap:0.375rem 1rem;margin:0;font-size:var(--font-size-14);line-height:1.375rem;letter-spacing:0.0145em}
.card .card-meta dt{color:var(--foreground-neutral-secondary)}
.card .card-meta dd{margin:0;min-width:0;color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary);overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.card .card-meta.columns{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:1.25rem 1.5rem}
.card .card-meta.columns > div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.25rem;min-width:0}
.card .card-meta.columns > .wide{grid-column:1 / -1}
.card .card-meta.columns dt{font-size:var(--font-size-13);line-height:1.125rem;letter-spacing:0.0194em;font-weight:500}
.card .card-meta.columns dd{font-size:var(--font-size-16);line-height:1.5rem;letter-spacing:0.0057em}
.card .card-meta.columns{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
.card.md{padding:var(--card-pad);gap:0.75rem}
.card.sm,.card.compact{padding:1rem;gap:0.5rem}
.card.sm .title,.card.compact .title{font-size:var(--font-size-14);line-height:1.25rem;letter-spacing:0.0145em}
.card.clickable{appearance:none;font:inherit;letter-spacing:inherit;color:inherit;text-align:left;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:box-shadow var(--motion-fast)}
.card.clickable>svg{flex:none;color:var(--foreground-neutral-secondary)}

.card.clickable:not(:disabled,[aria-disabled="true"]):hover{box-shadow:var(--shadow-2)}

.card.bordered.on{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--surface-brand-primary)}

.card-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(16.25rem,1fr));gap:var(--card-gap);width:100%;line-height:1.6}

.banner:not(.warning):not(.danger) .btn:is(.loading,[aria-disabled="true"]):focus-visible{outline-color:var(--brand-label)}
.spinner{display:inline-block;width:1.5rem;height:1.5rem;border:3px solid var(--line-neutral-secondary);border-top-color:var(--surface-brand-primary);border-radius:50%;animation:spin .8s linear infinite;line-height:1.6}

.skeleton{display:block;height:0.875rem;border-radius:var(--radius-md);background:var(--surface-neutral-strong);position:relative;overflow:hidden;line-height:1.6}

.progress i{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;translate:calc(var(--p,100%) - 100%) 0;background:var(--foreground-brand-primary);border-radius:var(--radius-full);transition:translate var(--motion-base)}

.sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
.steps{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem;list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;width:100%;max-width:none;font-size:var(--font-size-14);line-height:1.25rem;letter-spacing:0.0145em;font-weight:500}
.steps li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem;margin:0;white-space:nowrap;flex:none}
.steps li:not(:last-child){flex:1 1 auto}
.steps li:not(:last-child)::after{content:"";flex:1;min-width:1rem;height:2px;border-radius:var(--radius-full);background:var(--line-neutral-primary)}
.steps li.done:not(:last-child)::after{background:var(--surface-brand-primary)}
.steps li i{width:2rem;height:2rem;border-radius:50%;display:inline-grid;place-items:center;flex:none;font-style:normal;font-size:var(--font-size-14);line-height:1.25rem;letter-spacing:0.0145em;font-weight:600;border:1px solid var(--line-neutral-primary);background:transparent;color:var(--foreground-neutral-secondary)}

.steps .step-btn:hover .label{color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}

.steps li:not(.done) .step-btn:hover i{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.steps .step-btn:focus-visible{outline:none}
.steps .step-btn:focus-visible i{outline:1px solid var(--foreground-brand-primary);outline-offset:2px}
.steps.label-below{align-items:flex-start;gap:0}
.steps.label-below li,.steps.label-below li:not(:last-child){position:relative;flex:1 1 0;min-width:5rem;flex-direction:column;gap:0.5rem;white-space:normal;text-align:center}
.steps.label-below .step-btn{flex-direction:column}
.steps.label-below .label{word-break:keep-all}
.steps.label-below li:not(:last-child)::after{position:absolute;top:calc(1rem - 1px);left:calc(50% + 1.5rem);width:calc(100% - 3rem);min-width:0}
.steps.vertical,.steps.stacked{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:0}
.steps.vertical li,.steps.vertical li:not(:last-child),.steps.stacked li,.steps.stacked li:not(:last-child){position:relative;display:block;padding:0.375rem 0 1.5rem 2.75rem;min-height:3.5rem;white-space:normal;text-align:left}
.steps.vertical li:last-child,.steps.stacked li:last-child{padding-bottom:0;min-height:2rem}
.steps.vertical li i,.steps.stacked li i{position:absolute;left:0;top:0}
.steps.vertical .step-btn,.steps.stacked .step-btn{display:inline}
.steps.vertical li:not(:last-child)::after,.steps.stacked li:not(:last-child)::after{position:absolute;left:calc(1rem - 1px);top:2.5rem;bottom:0.5rem;width:2px;height:auto;min-width:0}
.stepper{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1.5rem;width:100%}

.step-panel:focus{outline:none}
.stepper .form{max-width:none}
.step-actions{display:flex;gap:0.5rem;justify-content:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap}

.form-actions.sticky,.step-actions.sticky{position:sticky;bottom:0;z-index:2;padding-bottom:1rem;margin-bottom:-1rem;background:var(--background-neutral-primary)}
.form .form-actions.sticky,.card .step-actions.sticky,.form .step-actions.sticky{background:var(--surface-elevated-primary)}
.step-actions.sticky{padding-top:calc(1rem - 1px);border-top:1px solid transparent}

.example-preview .form-actions.sticky:not(.form .form-actions),.example-preview .step-actions.sticky:not(.card .step-actions,.form .step-actions){background:var(--surface-elevated-primary)}
.tbl[data-row-nav] tbody tr:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--foreground-brand-primary);outline-offset:-1px}
.tbl-wrap{position:relative;overflow-x:auto;width:100%}

.tbl-wrap[aria-busy="true"] > .tbl > tbody{opacity:.5}
.tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:var(--font-size-14);margin:0;line-height:1.375rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:0.0145em}
.tbl th{text-align:left;font-weight:600;color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary);font-size:var(--font-size-13);height:2.75rem;padding:0 1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-neutral-secondary);white-space:nowrap;background:transparent;line-height:1.125rem;letter-spacing:0.0194em}
.tbl td{height:3rem;padding:0.75rem 1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-neutral-secondary);vertical-align:middle;background:var(--tbl-tint,transparent);font-size:var(--font-size-14);line-height:1.375rem;letter-spacing:0.0145em}

.tbl th.sortable .sort{appearance:none;border:0;background:transparent;padding:0;margin:0;font:inherit;letter-spacing:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;border-radius:var(--radius-xs)}
.tbl th.sortable .sort{position:relative}

.tbl th.sortable:hover{color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}

React · @jiran/ds-react
import { Avatar, Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbHome, BreadcrumbItem, Button, ButtonGroup, Card, CardHead, CardMeta, CardTitle, Combobox, Field, Form, Icon, Link, List, ListItem, PageHead, Row2, Stack, Steps, Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow, Tag, TextArea } from "@jiran/ds-react";

const OWNERS = ["이서연", "김민준", "박지훈", "최유진"].map((n) => ({ value: n, label: n }));
const LOG = [
  { text: "cryptor.dll 을 격리 저장소로 옮겼습니다", by: "이서연", at: "10:12" },
  { text: "분석 완료. 첨부 문서의 매크로로 들어왔습니다", by: "이서연", at: "09:58" },
];
const LOGS = [
  { time: "09:41:12", tone: "critical", lv: "CRIT", msg: "process.create blocked: rundll32.exe" },
  { time: "09:41:11", tone: "medium", lv: "WARN", msg: "usb.attach vendor=0x0781" },
] as const;

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <Stack>
      <PageHead as="h2"
        breadcrumb={
          <Breadcrumb>
            <BreadcrumbHome href="#" />
            <BreadcrumbItem href="#">사고</BreadcrumbItem>
            <BreadcrumbItem current>INC-0412</BreadcrumbItem>
          </Breadcrumb>
        }
        title="랜섬웨어 행위 탐지"
        sub="INC-0412 · 접수 09:41 · PC-2041"
        actions={<><ButtonGroup><Button variant="outline" color="assistive">단말 격리</Button><Button>조치 완료</Button></ButtonGroup></>}
      />
      {/* 단계 이동은 제품의 처리 버튼이 맡고 Steps 는 표시만 한다 */}
      <Steps aria-label="처리 단계" items={["접수", "분석", "조치", "종료"]} current={2} />
      <Row2>
        <Stack>
          <Card>
            <CardHead><CardTitle>처리 기록</CardTitle></CardHead>
            {/* 메모 칸은 기록 맨 위 — 칸 하나뿐이라 * 와 필수 안내를 두지 않는다 */}
            <Form bare validate onSubmit={(e) => e.preventDefault()}>
              <TextArea id="inc-memo" label="메모" required requiredMark={false} placeholder="처리한 일을 남기세요" help="감사 로그에도 남습니다." />
              <ButtonGroup end><Button type="submit" variant="outline">기록 추가</Button></ButtonGroup>
            </Form>
            <List>
              {LOG.map((l) => <ListItem key={l.at} leading={<Avatar size="sm" initials={l.by[0]} role="img" aria-label={l.by} />} primary={l.text} meta={`${l.by} · ${l.at}`} />)}
            </List>
          </Card>
          <Card flush>
            <CardHead>
              <CardTitle>관련 로그</CardTitle>
              <Button variant="text" color="assistive" size="sm" as="a" href="#" iconRight={<Icon name="chevron-right" size={16} />}>로그 뷰어에서 보기</Button>
            </CardHead>
            <Table density="compact" nowrap>
              <TableHead><TableRow><TableHeader>시간</TableHeader><TableHeader>심각도</TableHeader><TableHeader>메시지</TableHeader></TableRow></TableHead>
              <TableBody>
                {LOGS.map((r) => (
                  <TableRow key={r.time}>
                    <TableCell>{r.time}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell><Tag tone={r.tone} size="sm">{r.lv}</Tag></TableCell>
                    <TableCell>{r.msg}</TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          </Card>
        </Stack>
        <Card>
          <CardHead><CardTitle>요약</CardTitle></CardHead>
          <CardMeta items={[
            { label: "심각도", value: <Tag tone="critical" size="sm">Critical</Tag> },
            { label: "상태", value: <Tag tone="pending" size="sm">조치 중</Tag> },
            { label: "대상", value: <Link href="#">PC-2041</Link> },
          ]} />
          {/* 담당자는 여기서 바로 바꾼다 */}
          <Field label="담당자">
            <Combobox label="담당자" placeholder="담당자 검색" options={OWNERS} defaultValue="이서연" />
          </Field>
        </Card>
      </Row2>
    </Stack>
  );
}

React · @jiran/ds-react
import { Button, Card, CardHead, CardTitle, DataTable, Stack, type DataTableColumn } from "@jiran/ds-react";

type Row = { id: string; c0: string; c1: string; c2: string; c3: string };
const COLUMNS: DataTableColumn<Row>[] = [
  { key: "c0", header: "시간" },
  { key: "c1", header: "심각도" },
  { key: "c2", header: "사고" },
  { key: "c3", header: "담당자" },
];

/* 불러오는 중 · 빈 결과 · 오류 — 불러오기와 다시 시도는 제품이 하고, 표는 상태만 바꾼다 */
export default function Example() {
  return (
    <Stack>
      <Card flush>
        <CardHead><CardTitle>불러오는 중</CardTitle></CardHead>
        <DataTable columns={COLUMNS} rows={[] as Row[]} rowKey={(r) => r.id} status="loading" statusLabel="사고 목록 불러오는 중" loadingRows={3} />
      </Card>
      <Card flush>
        <CardHead><CardTitle>빈 결과</CardTitle></CardHead>
        <DataTable columns={COLUMNS} rows={[] as Row[]} rowKey={(r) => r.id} empty={<div className="empty">조건에 맞는 사고가 없습니다. 필터를 바꾸거나 지우세요. <Button size="sm" variant="outline" color="assistive">필터 초기화</Button></div>} />
      </Card>
      <Card flush>
        <CardHead><CardTitle>불러오기 실패</CardTitle></CardHead>
        <DataTable columns={COLUMNS} rows={[] as Row[]} rowKey={(r) => r.id} status="error" errorText="사고 목록을 불러오지 못했습니다. 네트워크 연결을 확인하고 다시 시도하세요." onRetry={() => {}} />
      </Card>
    </Stack>
  );
}

Rules

단계
접수 · 분석 · 조치 · 종료 네 단계를 Steps 로 보여 줍니다. 단계를 옮기는 일은 제품의 처리 버튼이 맡고, Steps 는 표시만 합니다.
요약
오른쪽에 심각도와 상태, 담당자, 대상을 키-값으로 둡니다. 담당자는 Combobox 로 바로 바꿀 수 있습니다.
처리 기록
누가 언제 무엇을 했는지 시간 순서로 쌓습니다. 메모를 남기는 칸은 기록 맨 위에 둡니다.
관련 로그
사고를 일으킨 로그를 몇 건 보여 주고, 같은 조건의 로그 뷰어로 가는 링크를 둡니다.
알림에서 오기
담당자로 지정되거나 단계가 바뀌면 알림 센터에 알림이 옵니다. 알림을 누르면 이 화면으로 옵니다.
종료
종료할 때는 원인과 조치를 남기게 합니다. 종료한 사고는 기록만 남고 담당자와 단계를 바꿀 수 없습니다.

Usage

React 제품은 디자인 시스템 패키지를 설치하고 스타일 파일을 한 번 불러오면 위 React 탭 코드를 그대로 쓸 수 있습니다. 설치 방법은 React Package 에 있습니다. HTML 제품은 공통 스타일 파일을 연결하고, 일부만 필요하면 아래 컴포넌트 CSS 를 복사합니다. 동작이 필요하면 동작 스크립트를 함께 넣습니다. 이 페이지의 미리보기도 그 스크립트로 움직입니다. 색은 모두 토큰을 따르므로 제품 색 하나를 고르면 나머지가 따라옵니다.

React @jiran/ds-react

npm i @jiran/ds-react

// main.tsx — 앱 진입점에서 한 번
import "@jiran/ds-react/style.css";

// 컴포넌트
import { PageHead, Steps, Card, Combobox, DataTable, Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbHome, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbMore, Button, ButtonGroup, Stepper, StepButton, CardHead, CardTitle, CardDesc, CardMeta, CardFoot, CardGrid, List, ListItem, Field, TextField, TextArea, CodeInput, Table, TableHead, TableBody, TableRow, TableHeader, TableCell, SelectButton, Tag, TagGroup, Avatar, AvatarGroup, Link, ActionBar, Spinner, Skeleton, SkeletonRow, Progress, Empty } from "@jiran/ds-react";

HTML

<!-- 1) 토큰 + 전체 컴포넌트 스타일 한 번에 연결 -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/style.css">
<!-- 동작(드롭다운·탭·달력·표 정렬/선택·토스트 등) — 순수 JS 한 파일. React 제품은 불필요 -->
<script src="assets/ds.js" defer></script>

<!-- 2) 또는 아래 "Component CSS" 만 프로젝트 CSS 에 붙이고,
        :root 토큰은 Foundations › Design Token 에서 복사 -->

복사본의 전제

아래 "Component CSS" 만 붙일 때는 이 규칙들과 Pretendard(assets/fonts) · :root 토큰을 전제로 그려집니다 — assets/style.css 의 값 그대로입니다. 앱에 같은 규칙이 있으면 넣지 않아도 됩니다.

*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--background-neutral-primary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary);font-family:var(--font-sans);font-size:var(--font-size-16);line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;word-break:keep-all;overflow-wrap:break-word}
code,kbd{font-family:var(--font-sans);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

Component CSS .page-head, .breadcrumb, .btn, .btn-group, .steps, .stepper, .step-panel, .step-actions, .sr-only, .card, .card-grid, .list, .avatar, .tag, .indicator, .field, .code-inputs, .tbl-wrap, .tbl, .tag-group, .tag-more, .avatar-group, .avatar-group-more, .combobox, .menu-state, .link, .action-bar, .select-notice, .checkbox, .spinner, .spinner-wrap, .skeleton, .skeleton-row, .progress, .progress-row, .empty, .stack, .row-2, .menu, .menu-item, .chip

/* JS Design System v0.9 · .page-head, .breadcrumb, .btn, .btn-group, .steps, .stepper, .step-panel, .step-actions, .sr-only, .card, .card-grid, .list, .avatar, .tag, .indicator, .field, .code-inputs, .tbl-wrap, .tbl, .tag-group, .tag-more, .avatar-group, .avatar-group-more, .combobox, .menu-state, .link, .action-bar, .select-notice, .checkbox, .spinner, .spinner-wrap, .skeleton, .skeleton-row, .progress, .progress-row, .empty, .stack, .row-2, .menu, .menu-item, .chip · 토큰(var(--*))은 assets/style.css :root 참고 */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:0.375rem;height:2.5rem;padding:0 1.25rem;border-radius:var(--radius-md);border:1px solid transparent;background:transparent;font:inherit;font-size:var(--font-size-14);font-weight:600;line-height:1.25rem;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;text-decoration:none;transition:background var(--motion-fast),border-color var(--motion-fast);letter-spacing:0.0145em}
.btn.sm{height:2rem;padding:0 0.875rem;font-size:var(--font-size-12);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);line-height:max(1rem,16px);letter-spacing:0.0252em}
.btn.md{height:2.5rem;padding:0 1.25rem;font-size:var(--font-size-14);line-height:1.25rem;letter-spacing:0.0145em}
.btn.lg{height:3rem;padding:0 1.625rem;font-size:var(--font-size-16);line-height:1.5rem;letter-spacing:0.0057em}
.btn:where(.solid.primary){background:var(--surface-brand-primary);background-image:var(--surface-brand-gradient);color:var(--brand-label)}
.btn:where(.solid.primary):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-brand-strong);background-image:var(--surface-brand-gradient-strong)}
.btn:where(.solid.primary):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-brand-heavy);background-image:var(--surface-brand-gradient-heavy)}
.btn:where(.outline.primary){border-color:var(--line-brand-strong);color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.btn:where(.outline.primary):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle)}
.btn:where(.outline.primary):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong)}
.btn:where(.solid.assistive){background:var(--surface-neutral-tertiary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.solid.assistive):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.btn:where(.solid.assistive):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.btn:where(.outline.assistive){border-color:var(--line-neutral-primary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.outline.assistive):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.btn:where(.outline.assistive):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.btn:where(.solid.negative){background:var(--surface-negative-primary);color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}
.btn:where(.solid.negative):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-negative-strong)}
.btn:where(.solid.negative):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-negative-heavy)}
.btn:where(.outline.negative){border-color:var(--line-negative-primary);color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}
.btn:where(.outline.negative):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-negative-hover)}
.btn:where(.outline.negative):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-negative-pressed);border-color:var(--line-negative-strong)}
.btn:where(.text){color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.btn.text{padding-left:0.5rem;padding-right:0.5rem}
.btn:where(.text):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle)}
.btn:where(.text):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong)}
.btn:where(.text.assistive){color:var(--foreground-neutral-secondary)}
.notice.danger .btn:where(.text){color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.text.assistive):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.text.assistive):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn.icon-only{width:2.5rem;padding:0}
.btn.icon-only.sm{width:2rem}
.btn.icon-only.lg{width:3rem}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).primary){color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).primary):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).primary):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).assistive){color:var(--foreground-neutral-secondary)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).assistive):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).assistive):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).negative){color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).negative):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-negative-hover)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).negative):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-negative-pressed)}
.btn svg{width:1.25rem;height:1.25rem;flex:none}
.btn.sm svg{width:1rem;height:1rem}
.btn.lg svg{width:1.75rem;height:1.75rem;stroke-width:1.6}
.btn.block{width:100%}
.btn[disabled],.btn[aria-disabled="true"]{background:var(--surface-disable-primary);border-color:transparent;color:var(--foreground-disable-primary);cursor:not-allowed}
.btn:where(.outline)[disabled],.btn:where(.outline)[aria-disabled="true"]{background:transparent;border-color:var(--surface-disable-primary)}
.btn:where(.text,.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline))[disabled],.btn:where(.text,.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline))[aria-disabled="true"]{background:transparent}
.btn.loading{position:relative;color:transparent;cursor:progress}
.btn.loading::after{content:"";position:absolute;box-sizing:border-box;width:1.25rem;height:1.25rem;border:2px solid currentColor;border-right-color:transparent;border-radius:50%;color:var(--brand-label);animation:spin .8s linear infinite}
.btn.sm.loading::after{width:1rem;height:1rem}
.btn.lg.loading::after{width:1.75rem;height:1.75rem}
.btn:where(.assistive).loading::after{color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.btn:where(.outline.primary,.text:not(.assistive),.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).primary).loading::after{color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.btn:where(.negative:not(.text)).loading::after{color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}
.btn-group{display:inline-flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0.5rem;align-items:center;line-height:1.6}
.btn-group.end{justify-content:flex-end;width:100%}
.btn-group.vertical{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}
.btn-group:has(> .btn.sm){gap:0.375rem}
.btn-group:has(> .btn.lg){gap:0.75rem}
.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.375rem;min-width:16.25rem;font-size:var(--font-size-14);line-height:1.375rem;letter-spacing:0.0145em}
.field label:where(:not(.checkbox):not(.radio)){font-weight:600}
.field label em{color:var(--foreground-negative-strong);font-style:normal;margin-left:2px}
.field label b{font-weight:700}
.field input:where(:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]):not([type=range])),.field textarea{height:2.5rem;border:1px solid var(--line-neutral-primary);border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:0 0.875rem;font:inherit;font-size:var(--font-size-14);background:var(--surface-elevated-primary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary);width:100%;transition:border-color var(--motion-fast),box-shadow var(--motion-fast);line-height:1.375rem;letter-spacing:0.0145em}
.field textarea{height:auto;min-height:6rem;padding:0.625rem 0.875rem;resize:vertical;line-height:1.375rem}
.field input::placeholder,.field textarea::placeholder{color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary)}
.field input:where(:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]):not([type=range])):focus,.field textarea:focus-within{border-color:var(--line-field-focus);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--line-field-focus-halo);outline:none}
.field input:where(:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]):not([type=range])):disabled,.field textarea:disabled{background:var(--surface-disable-primary);color:var(--foreground-disable-primary);cursor:not-allowed}
.field input:where(:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]):not([type=range])):read-only:not(:disabled){background:var(--background-neutral-secondary)}

.auth > .link{align-self:center;font-size:var(--font-size-14);line-height:1.25rem;letter-spacing:0.0145em}
@keyframes ds-pop{from{opacity:0;translate:0 -0.25rem;scale:.98}}
@keyframes ds-pop-up{from{opacity:0;translate:0 0.25rem;scale:.98}}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes ds-delay{from{visibility:hidden}to{visibility:visible}}
@keyframes shimmer{to{transform:translateX(100%)}}
@keyframes pulse{70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px transparent}}
